# Forwend

> Forwend lets businesses and freelancers get paid in stablecoins through invoices, payment links and checkout. A client can pay with almost any token on almost any chain through NEAR Intents, and the business receives USDC.

Forwend is under active development. Test mode runs on testnets. Live mode runs on Base, Arbitrum, Arc and Tempo mainnets as a development deployment, not yet for other people's money.

Each payment lands in its own contract, which settles it to the profile's wallet. Forwend accepts USDC on Base, Arbitrum and Arc, and stablecoins on Tempo. Cross-chain payments work in live mode only and arrive as USDC on Base.

How to use Forwend:

- Sign in at https://forwend.com/sign-in, then create an invoice or a payment link and share its pay link. The client pays from any wallet or exchange.
- To take payments on your own site, use a merchant profile with a store. Open Developers and create a secret API key for that store. Keys start with `fw_live_`, or `fw_test_` in Developer mode.
- Your server creates a checkout session with the `forwend` package, at the API base URL https://forwend.com/api. Keep the key on the server.
- Send the client to the session's hosted checkout, or embed it with `@forwend/js` or `@forwend/react` using the session's `payToken`.
- Fulfil an order only after your server verifies the signed webhook and reads the payment as paid.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://forwend.com/docs): start here
- [Choose an integration](https://forwend.com/docs/start/choose-an-integration): invoices, payment links, hosted or embedded checkout
- [Your first test payment](https://forwend.com/docs/start/first-test-payment)
- [Authentication and keys](https://forwend.com/docs/integrate/authentication)
- [Server setup](https://forwend.com/docs/integrate/server-setup): the `forwend` Node package
- [Browser packages](https://forwend.com/docs/integrate/browser-packages): `@forwend/js` and `@forwend/react`
- [Webhooks and verification](https://forwend.com/docs/integrate/webhooks)
- [Payment status](https://forwend.com/docs/integrate/payment-status)
- [Cross-chain payments](https://forwend.com/docs/payments/cross-chain): paying with other tokens through NEAR Intents
- [Networks and tokens](https://forwend.com/docs/reference/networks)
- [Errors](https://forwend.com/docs/reference/errors)

## API reference

- [Invoices](https://forwend.com/docs/api/invoices)
- [Checkout sessions](https://forwend.com/docs/api/checkout-sessions)
- [Stores](https://forwend.com/docs/api/stores)
- [Tokens](https://forwend.com/docs/api/tokens)
- [Webhook events](https://forwend.com/docs/api/webhook-events)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/Forwend/forwend/blob/main/apps/backend/api/openapi.yaml)

## Packages

- [forwend](https://www.npmjs.com/package/forwend): the server package for Node 20 or later: checkout sessions, payments, invoices, stores, webhook events and `verifyWebhook`
- [@forwend/js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@forwend/js): the checkout in any web page: a pay link, the full checkout or its pay panel
- [@forwend/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@forwend/react): the same checkout for React 18 and 19: `PayButton`, `Checkout` and `PaymentElement`

## Code

- [Repository](https://github.com/Forwend/forwend): the web app, Go backend, contracts and packages, under the MIT license
- [Example merchant](https://github.com/Forwend/forwend/tree/main/apps/example-merchant): a sample shop that uses the packages and verifies webhooks
